newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilians clash with police after pastor's death.
newsitem.headline: Brazilians clash with police after pastor's death.

text.p: Demonstrators protesting the death in police custody of an evangelical preacher set fire to a police station in a town in eastern Brazil on Sunday, a local news agency reported.
Trouble broke out after 400 people marched through the town of Ibipora in Parana state to protest the death a week earlier of pastor Jose Idalecio Bueno, Estado news agency said.

Police said Bueno choked on his vomit in the back of a police van after he committed a traffic violation and resisted arrest. His wife and son who witnessed the incident said he was beaten, Estado reported.
After hurling rocks at a highway patrol headquarters, demonstrators set fire to the building and to cars. Police fired tear gas to disperse the crowd.
National CBN radio said one person was arrested but did not give details of any injuries.
